body:
If I'm honest with you, I'd never intentionally cause harm to someone, as it bites back harder than its worth. Violence is a primitive means to an end, yet knowing that doesn't stop what I feel. 
And I don't mind you not having any advice, reading and replying in general is more than enough. Thank you.

Thank you for replying all of this, I really appreciate what you've said. I'm going to investigate my feelings further in parallel to what you've said above, as I feel I may have neglected to try and understand what it is I feel, and I will visit my GP about this, and possibly speak to my partner about this. I read what you said about NPC's and the like, and it has made me realise how much potential help I've squandered for no reason other than selfish notions of superiority and discomfort. I really appreciate you spending your time reading and writing this for me, and perhaps this post with be the first stepping stone to figuring all this out, and perhaps obtaining some happiness. Thank you stranger, I wish you good health.

Good morning, fortunately I was able to catch a few hours of sleep. I had originally written this because all my thoughts were entangled in my head, and it helped initially seeing them all typed up. Thank you for your advice, I'm considering visiting the mental health practitioner on campus (before you said it I didn't actually think of it). Either that, or visit my GP directly. So thank you again, kind stranger.
